description:
Rear
T2	Silver Birch x 1 (Betula pendula / alba)
This tree planted by us is doing well but has grown un-evenly due to shading.
Suggested work:
- Reduce the right hand side of the canopy by approx 1-2m to create a uniform crown. 
- Shape remainder of tree to tidy approx 0.5m, avoiding cutting the top.
- finishing dimensions of 5m in height and 3.5m in diameter
Rear
T3	Palm x 1	
This tree is growing well but is due to be maintained. 
Suggested work: 
- Remove dead and dying frongs
- current dimensions of the palm are approx. 6m in height by 1m in diameter and this will not be affected as we are only planning to remove deadwood.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
decision_conditions: The specification is not suitable and therefore needs to be confirmed. The specification needs to be measurable and quantifiable so that we can understand the amount that is to be removed in meters. We need to know the amount to be removed and the remaining crown size. E.g. 2m crown reduction in width and 2m reduction in height, leaving a canopy spread of 3m and height of 5m
